baseline: 222 supplied catalog entries; no claim of universal firmware/controller availability or full type emulation
source_formatting: HTML/trailing whitespace formatting removed; asterisks retained as catalog annotations, not identifier characters.

numeric_model.label: Numeric model (bounded)
numeric_model.remaining: Complete forms/conversions, math flags, edge behavior and native parity.

wide_rll_profile.label: Wide integer profile (bounded)
wide_rll_profile.remaining: Mixed types, additional ST forms, wide CPT/CMP/MEQ, math flags and native/target qualification.

timer_counter_model.label: Timer/counter model (partial)
timer_counter_model.remaining: Full fields/state transitions, alternate instructions and clock/fault/status parity.

string_model.label: STRING model (partial)
string_model.remaining: All string forms/instructions/encodings and complete built-in wire behavior.

control_model.label: CONTROL model (partial)
control_model.remaining: Native layouts/transfers, remaining consumers/forms and full scan/status/fault parity.

fbd_timer_model.label: FBD_TIMER model (partial)
fbd_timer_model.remaining: Bounded ST TONR/TOFR/RTOR; FBD graphs, native clock/status/fault/layout parity and other profiles remain unfinished.

fbd_counter_model.label: FBD_COUNTER model (partial)
fbd_counter_model.remaining: Bounded ST CTUD; FBD graphs, complete native reset/overflow/status/layout/fault parity and other profiles remain unfinished.

fbd_oneshot_model.label: FBD_ONESHOT model (partial)
fbd_oneshot_model.remaining: Bounded ST OSRI/OSFI; FBD graphs, mixed-kind records, native layout/lifecycle/fault parity and other profiles remain unfinished.

scale_model.label: SCALE model (partial)
scale_model.remaining: Bounded finite-REAL ST SCL; FBD graphs, native precision/overflow/status/layout/fault parity and other profiles remain unfinished.

hl_limit_model.label: HL_LIMIT model (partial)
hl_limit_model.remaining: Bounded ST HLL limits, alarms and status; FBD graphs, native precision/overflow/status/layout/fault parity and other profiles remain unfinished.

selectable_negate_model.label: SELECTABLE_NEGATE model (partial)
selectable_negate_model.remaining: Bounded ST SNEG selectable finite-REAL negation; FBD graphs, native precision/overflow/status/layout/fault parity and other profiles remain unfinished.

selected_summer_model.label: SELECTED_SUMMER model (partial)
selected_summer_model.remaining: Bounded ST SSUM selected weighted inputs and bias; FBD graphs, native precision/overflow/status/layout/fault parity and other profiles remain unfinished.

rate_limiter_model.label: RATE_LIMITER model (partial)
rate_limiter_model.remaining: Bounded ST RLIM period/oversample ramps; module timestamp timing, FBD graphs and native timing/precision/status/layout/fault parity remain unfinished.

moving_statistics_model.label: Moving statistics model (partial)
moving_statistics_model.remaining: Bounded ST MAVE/MSTD finite REAL queues; FBD graphs, packed layouts and native queue/resize/hold/lifecycle/precision/status/fault parity remain unfinished.

no_dedicated_model.label: No dedicated model
no_dedicated_model.remaining: Verified schema/layout plus associated stateful runtime behavior and conformance cases.

atomic.label: Atomic numeric/BOOL
atomic.remaining: Complete type operations, conversions, flags and target profiles.

time.label: Time/date
time.remaining: Implement exact typed storage, literals, units, operations, clock interaction and transfers.

timer_counter.label: Timers/counters
timer_counter.remaining: Complete dedicated fields, instruction states, time behavior and native fault/status parity.

string.label: Strings
string.remaining: Complete capacities/encoding, backing storage, instructions and wire models.

control.label: Array/control state
control.remaining: Expand remaining shift/FIFO/LIFO/sequencer forms, aggregate transfers, conversions and file consumers; qualify native layout/status parity.

alarm.label: Alarms
alarm.remaining: Define alarm/set state, operations, periodic evaluation, event lifecycle and consumers.

motion.label: Motion/axis/reference
motion.remaining: Define axes, references, groups, trajectories/cams and instruction state on the simulation clock.

metal_form.label: Metal forming/valves
metal_form.remaining: Define configuration/state and linked metal-form/valve instruction models.

safety.label: Safety
safety.remaining: Define layouts and separate logical Safety instruction/lifecycle profiles; no certification claim.

fbd.label: FBD state/logic
fbd.remaining: Define block state and implement FBD execution order, pins, enable/reset and scan behavior.

process.label: Process/filter/drive
process.remaining: Define configuration/state, timing, numeric algorithms, limits and consumer instruction semantics.

plantpax.label: PlantPAx/bus
plantpax.remaining: Define public/private storage, ownership/mode/alarm state, instruction behavior and target applicability.

rac.label: RAC interfaces
rac.remaining: Define interface structures, commands/acknowledgements/status and explicit device behavior.

module.label: Module/connection
module.remaining: Implement module identity/topology, I/O connection state, faults, diagnostics and cyclic behavior.

message.label: Message/serial
message.remaining: Define asynchronous control state, configuration, queues, paths, replies, timeouts and cancellation.

phase_sequence.label: Phase/sequence
phase_sequence.remaining: Define phase/sequence records, step/transition state, ownership, commands and lifecycle.

sfc.label: SFC state
sfc.remaining: Define active steps/actions/stops, qualifiers, timers and chart execution lifecycle.

energy.label: Energy
energy.remaining: Define configuration/measurement/status and consumers; empty discovery is not execution.

datalog.label: Data logging
datalog.remaining: Define trigger/status, record buffering, timestamps, retention and file/storage behavior.

hmi.label: HMI button control
hmi.remaining: Define button/control state and linked HMIBC execution/handshakes.

external_routine.label: External routine
external_routine.remaining: Define ABI/parameters/lifecycle and an explicit supported code backend; descriptors do not execute code.

opcua.label: Controller OPC UA
opcua.remaining: Qualify firmware, then define controller-server configuration/status and runtime; separate from an external bridge.
